# KULTRA Studio

> Premium 100% Australian Merino Wool Desk Mats engineered for high-performance workspace setups, mechanical keyboard acoustic dampening, and desk protection.

## Core Products & Specifications

- [100% Merino Wool Desk Mat](https://usekultra.com): Solid 3.0mm Grade-A Australian Merino wool felt desk mat ($80.00 USD) featuring zero-slide micro-grip dot backing, -14dB acoustic keyboard noise dampening, and water-repellent finish.
